instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: This medium-sized firm develops subscription-based AI tools for supply chain optimization. They operate in a high-growth but highly regulated sector, requiring constant updates to data privacy and industry compliance standards.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company recently launched three minor feature upgrades based on user feedback. A larger strategic initiative involved piloting an integration with a new logistics platform last year.
answers.strategicGoals: To establish market leadership in the core optimization space while aggressively diversifying revenue streams into adjacent industry verticals like healthcare and specialized consulting.
answers.teamSize: The team consists of 25 dedicated software engineers, product managers, and a lean executive group focused on rapid iteration.
answers.additionalContext: The market is saturated with similar tools, demanding continuous innovation and rapid pivots to maintain relevance.

opportunities.title: Vertical Spin-off Platform Development
opportunities.rationale: Given the bold risk appetite and diversification goal, developing a completely new SaaS product line targeting Healthcare or FinTech will allow the company to enter high-margin, less saturated markets.

first_actions: Conduct comprehensive market gap analysis in two target verticals (Healthcare/Fintech).
Establish a dedicated cross-functional task force and hire 2 key domain experts.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve $1M ARR from the new vertical within 18 months.
milestones: Q2: MVP launch of Vertical X platform.
Q4: Secure first five anchor enterprise clients.

opportunities.title: API Marketplace Expansion
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing core technology, creating a structured marketplace for third-party integrations will increase platform stickiness and diversify revenue beyond direct subscriptions.

first_actions: Define monetization model (commission/tier structure) for marketplace access.
Develop technical documentation and onboarding workflow.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase average customer revenue by 20% through new marketplace fees.
milestones: Q3: Launch MVP of the API Marketplace.
Q1 Next Year: Achieve 50 active third-party developers.

opportunities.title: Acquisition of Niche Compliance Firm
opportunities.rationale: To rapidly diversify into the regulated space (e.g., specialized compliance consulting or data security), acquiring a smaller, established firm is faster than building an internal capability.

first_actions: Identify 3-5 small boutique firms specializing in specific industry regulations.
Develop preliminary valuation and due diligence framework.
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful integration and revenue contribution from acquired entity within 9 months.
milestones: Q3: Finalize Target List and Initiate Outreach.
Q4: Complete Acquisition and integrate systems.

next_steps.action: Form a dedicated 'Diversification Task Force' meeting bi-weekly to prioritize the Radical Spin-off Platform.
Develop technical specifications and business model for the API Marketplace expansion and assign engineering lead.
Initiate confidential scouting of small compliance firms suitable for acquisition target profiles.

key_weaknesses: High reliance on a single core technology stack, limiting external market entry speed.
Insufficient expertise in complex regulatory environments outside the immediate core industry.
Slow internal process for testing and scaling radical new product concepts.
Talent retention risk due to competitive poaching from larger tech giants.
